# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 19 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 19
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. But the way of the Black One is crooked and full of cursing; for it is a way of eternal death with punishment, in which are the things that destroy souls: idolatry, arrogance, exaltation of power, hypocrisy, double-heartedness, adultery, murder, robbery, pride, transgression, deceit, malice, stubbornness, sorcery, magic, covetousness, the lack of the fear of God.
2. It is the way of persecutors of the good, haters of truth, lovers of lying, who do not know the reward of righteousness, who do not cleave to the good nor to righteous judgment, who give no attention to the widow and the orphan, who watch, not for the fear of God, but for what is evil — from whom meekness and patience are far distant, who love vanity and pursue recompense, who have no compassion for the poor man, who do not labor for the one who is burdened with toil, who are ready for slander, who do not know their maker, who are murderers of children, who are corrupters of what God has fashioned, who turn away from the needy, who oppress the afflicted, who are advocates of the rich, lawless judges of the poor, utterly sinful in all things.
